role_in_the_chain: Creates the request and grants access
work_performed: Defines the problem property timing budget access and contact permissions
value_or_revenue: Diagnosis comparison confidence and completed work
minimum_evidence_needed: A specific serviceable brief and permission for the disclosed handoff
limitations: Guidance and survey evidence do not prove behaviour in every category

work_performed: Builds the proposition acquires traffic explains intermediary status captures consent and measures the source
value_or_revenue: Call lead appointment territory affiliate or transaction revenue
minimum_evidence_needed: Truthful identity source attribution consent record and consumer value
limitations: The work varies materially between a small publisher and a scaled network

work_performed: Researches the service creates useful pages maintains technical search quality and builds conversion journeys
value_or_revenue: Organic acquisition and reusable owned media
minimum_evidence_needed: Original evidence accountable authorship technical reliability and no doorway or scaled-content abuse
limitations: Search visibility is variable and is not a completed lead or job

role_in_the_chain: Buys demand while organic evidence develops
work_performed: Runs search or social campaigns controls geography and sends demand into tracked journeys
value_or_revenue: Fast test traffic and controllable volume
minimum_evidence_needed: Channel cost lead source consent landing-page truth and cohort economics
limitations: Provider claims about campaign volume and performance remain unaudited

role_in_the_chain: Turns an enquiry into a usable opportunity
work_performed: Checks contact details ownership service fit timing and willingness to speak then books or transfers
minimum_evidence_needed: Script outcome call status consent and exact rejection rules
limitations: Human qualification adds labour cost and selected providers publish few audited cohorts

work_performed: Agrees service area capacity acceptance replacement price caps reporting and escalation
minimum_evidence_needed: Named economic buyer written lead definition and feedback obligation
limitations: Buyer interviews and real contracts remain missing

role_in_the_chain: Scopes quotes and fulfils the job
work_performed: Maintains credentials answers promptly visits or diagnoses prices the work completes it and reports outcome
value_or_revenue: Job gross contribution repeat business and referrals
minimum_evidence_needed: Current registration insurance service radius diary capacity and job outcome
limitations: Registration and willingness to receive leads do not prove workmanship or commercial fit

role_in_the_chain: Mediates discovery and may sell leads directly
work_performed: Ranks summarises maps verifies profiles sells ads and routes eligible local-service enquiries
value_or_revenue: Advertising revenue engagement and platform control
minimum_evidence_needed: Current platform policy visibility and source-level attribution
limitations: Availability ranking and interface behaviour change by query location and time

work_performed: Vets profiles collects reviews matches requests unlocks contacts or controls booking and payment
value_or_revenue: Membership credits shortlist fees lead fees or take rate
minimum_evidence_needed: Transparent vetting review matching pricing and dispute rules
limitations: Public pricing does not reveal category-level liquidity or typical buyer return

work_performed: Checks or publishes identity competence scheme status insurance or complaint standards
minimum_evidence_needed: Verifiable scope status expiry and checking method
limitations: A credential may be necessary without guaranteeing service quality

work_performed: Attributes calls and forms applies buyer rules logs delivery manages credits and reconciles outcomes
minimum_evidence_needed: Event ledger buyer rule audit trail retention controls and delivery alerts
limitations: Tooling records the process but does not create demand or provider capacity

work_performed: Defines advertising privacy review consumer-rights and category-specific requirements
value_or_revenue: Trust redress and lawful market operation
minimum_evidence_needed: Current authoritative guidance and category-specific legal review
limitations: Guidance is not legal advice and application depends on the facts
